summary: Batangas 4th District representative with 86 principal-authored bills, mainly provincial-road conversions. Rubric-relevant items found were co-authorship of the national minimum wage and of the bill postponing barangay and SK elections. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Principal-authored bills reviewed were local roads; the rubric-relevant items are co-authored only.
